description: This file manages Slack execution approval logic, including normalization of approver IDs, resolving approvers, checking target recipients, and configuring approval profiles for Slack within the openclaw project.

methods.name: normalizeSlackApproverId
methods.description: Normalizes Slack approver identifiers from various formats to a standard ID or undefined.

methods.name: resolveSlackOwnerApprovers
methods.description: Resolves the list of owner approvers from the configuration.

methods.name: getSlackExecApprovalApprovers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of approvers authorized for Slack execution approval based on configuration and account info.

methods.name: isSlackExecApprovalTargetRecipient
methods.description: Checks if a given sender is a target recipient for Slack execution approval.
